history.summary: GENERIC-NAME / IDENTITY-UNCERTAINTY FLAG: web research finds no major temple called 'Shri Mansa Devi Mandir' in Patiala city, and no published history, festival calendar, or management details for any such shrine — do not invent facts. The best-supported referent is a small local Hindu shrine listed as 'Shri Radha Krishan Mansa Devi Mandir' at Noddha Misser Street, Jatta Wala Chontra, Saifabad Gate / Gur Mandi, Patiala 147001 (30.32543, 76.40589), with a second listing 'Mansa Devi Temple' at 926/2 Bhindian Street, Patiala (30.327756, 76.404372) — both in Patiala's old city within a few hundred metres of each other, possibly the same shrine under different names. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: this is NOT the famous Mata Mansa Devi at Panchkula, Haryana (documented in seq 801) — that major Shakti temple in the Shivalik foothills (main temple built 1811–1815 by Maharaja Gopal Singh of Manimajra; second 'Patiala temple' built 1840 by Maharaja Karam Singh of Patiala) is the well-known shrine near Chandigarh. This CSV row is a modest Patiala neighborhood shrine. CSV town Patiala is correct as given.

travel.road: In Patiala's old city near Gur Mandi and Saifabad Gate; reached by auto or cycle rickshaw from the station area.
